label: Cooldown bands
description: How often an ability can be used: the wait from one use until it can be used again. Band the source's cooldown figure alone; do not add the time the effect lasts. Use real seconds at the game's normal multiplayer speed (StarCraft II: Faster). Where the source gives a span ("8 to 12 seconds", "up to 15 seconds"), band its largest value. For an ability with charges, band the time to regain one charge. Edges are exact, and a value on an edge takes the higher band. An ability that comes back only at a resupply point or on respawn is per-life, with or without a figure. An ability with no wait has no band: leave cooldown out. That covers instant orders such as unloading, and mode switches that only take time to finish; say in the summary, in words, how long the switch takes. An ability held back only by a stock, such as Company of Heroes munitions or the unit's energy, has no band unless the source also gives a cooldown.

terms.label: Spammable
terms.description: Under 5 seconds; several uses in every fight.

terms.label: Short
terms.description: From 5 up to but not including 15 seconds; a couple of uses per fight.

terms.label: Medium
terms.description: From 15 up to but not including 45 seconds; roughly once per fight.

terms.label: Long
terms.description: 45 seconds or more; a few uses per life.

terms.label: Once per life
terms.description: One use per life or purchase, restocked only at a resupply point or on respawn.
